settings.placeHint: Places and locks: the reference is in Loussa Places (via Loussa Bookings).

connexions.intro: Addresses and tokens for the LoussaSuite apps and connected services. Secrets are encrypted in the database (AES-256-GCM) and never shown again: only their last 4 characters appear. Details: docs/secrets.md.
connexions.keyMissingText: ROCKET_SECRETS_KEY is not set in the server environment: secrets cannot be saved.
connexions.envText: Run "npm run secrets:import-env" on the server to import them into the database, then remove them from .env.
connexions.bricksIntro: LoussaSuite applications. Loussa Cloud goes through Loussa Bookings; Loussa Mail can also be connected directly for mailboxes (shared and personal); Loussa Login (single sign-on) is set in the server environment.
connexions.homeyNote: Homey address and mode (local/cloud): property settings › {link}.
connexions.combinedTitle: Loussa Mail · Loussa Cloud · Loussa Login
connexions.combinedDesc: Mailer (email sending) and Cloud (files) are reached through Loussa Bookings: nothing to enter here. Loussa Login: server ROCKET_AUTH_… variables.
connexions.combinedBody: Without Loussa Bookings, emails go out through the IMAP/SMTP mailbox and files stay in Loussa Space.
connexions.directIntro: Third-party services connected directly to Loussa Space: Lodgify, Nuki, Homey, mailbox, n8n webhook and plugins / connectors per property.
connexions.connectorSecretsHelp: Tokens for "Web service" connectors…: the connector gives the name (CONNECTOR_…), the value is entered here.
connexions.confirmClear: Clear this secret? The related service will stop working.

connectors.title: Connectors
connectors.none: No connectors. "Add" to connect a service (Homey, web service…).
connectors.docsText: Fetches the service's documents into the Documents tab (folder "Connectors / {name}"), without duplicates.
connectors.pick: Pick a connector, or add one from the plugin library.
connectors.removeConfirm: Delete connector "{name}"? Documents already fetched stay in the Documents tab.
connectors.homeyOff: Homey account not connected (Home automation tab)

plugins.title: Plugin / connector library
plugins.intro: Plugins are the services the app can connect. In each property ({tab} tab), you create one or more connectors from these plugins — for example two Homeys, or several web services to fetch documents.
plugins.pmsOff: Not connected: properties, bookings and locks still come directly from Lodgify and Nuki.
plugins.pmsOk: Connected: properties and bookings come from Loussa Bookings.
plugins.usedBy: Not used yet | Used by {n} connector | Used by {n} connectors
plugins.footer: To connect a service without a dedicated plugin, use "Web service" (any web API). Secrets (tokens, keys) are entered in the "Connector secrets" card above under a name starting with {prefix} (encrypted, never shown again).

users.title: Users
users.intro: An account is created {noPassword}: the person sets it by following a {link} (72 h). The link is shown to you only once; you can also email it in one click. The role and allowed properties apply immediately.
users.auditIntro: The last 100 events: sign-ins, failures, password changes, account management. No passwords or links appear here.
users.onlyOnce: This link is shown only once
users.linkWarning: It is personal, single-use, and expires on {date}. Anyone who has it can set the password for {name}: pass it on only to that person.
users.confirmSendInvite: Send the invitation link by email to {email}?
users.confirmSendReset: Send the reset link by email to {email}?
users.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {name}? Their sessions are closed immediately.

roleHelp.admin: Everything, including settings, accounts and connectors.
roleHelp.gestionnaire: Bookings, codes, documents, Balance sheet, stock and home automation for their properties. Not settings, email or contacts.
roleHelp.comptable: Documents and Balance sheet for their properties, read-only.

imports.toSortIntro: Imported documents (n8n workflows, emails…) with no recognized property. Pick the property, check the category, date and amount, then file them: they then appear in the property's Documents tab and count toward its balance sheet.
imports.unassignedIntro: Imported statement lines with no recognized property: they are not counted in any balance sheet until assigned.
imports.statementLines: {n} statement lines|{n} statement line|{n} statement lines
imports.tokenMissing: ⚠ The {token} token is not set ({link}): imports are rejected.
imports.howToText: An n8n workflow sends its documents to {docs} and its statement lines to {tx}, with the {header} header (the token is entered in Settings › Connections; it is never shown again). One {source} per platform (airbnb, booking…); an {externalId} prevents duplicates if the workflow retries. Details and examples: {file}.
imports.confirmDeleteDoc: Permanently delete "{title}"? The file will be erased.
imports.confirmDeleteTx: Delete all statement lines imported from "{source}"? You will be able to re-import them.

activation.title: Account activation
activation.done: Password saved. You can now sign in with the username {username}.
activation.askNew: Ask the administrator for a new link.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.sent: If an account matches this username or address and has an email address, a message with a reset link (valid for 1 hour) has just been sent.
forgot.nothing: Nothing received? Check your spam folder, or ask the administrator for a link.

restock.intro: End of cleaning: tap the status of each item.
restock.none: No items to track for this property.

brick.default: Loussa Bookings is connected: this local page stays available but the reference is in the app.

bgSearch.placeholder: Search for an image (e.g. beach, mountain, forest…)
bgSearch.note: Public domain images (Openverse), no account or key, no attribution required.

docsApi.title: API — Swagger documentation
docsApi.intro: Generated from the permissions table: it lists, for each route, the allowed roles and the scope. "Try it out" uses your session (writes take real effect).
